import numpy as np
def get_bnd(f):
    d=np.load(f); Ds,eps,TH=d['Ds'],d['eps'],d['TH'].astype(float)
    bnd=np.array([eps[np.where(TH[:,i]>=1)[0][-1]] if TH[0,i]>=1 else np.nan
                  for i in range(len(Ds))])
    return Ds,bnd

print(f"max |boundary(NW=48) - boundary(NW=24)| = {np.nanmax(abs(b48-b24i)):.5f}")
print(f"mean |diff| = {np.nanmean(abs(b48-b24i)):.5f}  (eps grid step 5e-5)")
# slopes on COMMON physical scale h=0.03, both runs
for tag,D,b in [("NW=24",D24,b24),("NW=48",D48,b48)]:
    out=[]
    for Dq in (2.05,2.08,2.10,2.12,2.15,2.20):
        i=np.argmin(abs(D-Dq)); n=max(int(0.03/(D[1]-D[0])),3)
        sl=(b[i]-b[i-n])/(D[i]-D[i-n]); sr=(b[i+n]-b[i])/(D[i+n]-D[i])
        out.append(f"{Dq}:{sr-sl:+.3f}")
    print(f"{tag} slope jumps (h=0.03): "+"  ".join(out))
